scope: every art/MANIFEST.json entry of family 3d (props, scenes, characters, avatars, glossy arrows, app icon), merged with the lane scratch manifests (characters, 3d-hud, 3d-events, scene), + the composed home and loading proofs
method: Judged at GAME SIZE (1x the pt frame on a 393x852 screen, 3 px/pt @3x viewed at ~1-2 px/pt), never close-up: manifest_sheets side-by-sides (reference | ours on the ref backdrop | ours in place), compact contacts, and composed screens next to the reference shot at the same scale. Colours checked against STYLE.md's untinted samples where they apply. Lane self-grades are listed for comparison only.

scale.B: ok (same art, visible differences only on inspection)
scale.C: redo (different at a glance, wrong size/colour/silhouette, or a defect)

Composed on 002 at game size, it reads as the same character recoloured pink: same pose, size, eye line, coat, badge and pen. Minor: the crown tuft is a thin side wisp (002: a centred spiky tuft). entries.fix: Remove the speckle band; model the press + girder + conveyor; soft warm light/haze; bake contact shadows under the cast.

composed.note: At game size the composed home (scene layers + the three rigs at rig.json placement_pt + a mocked top bar / streak badge / LEVEL plate / Play / nav) reads as 002/026: same layout, lighting and characters (pink scientist, blue workers). Three things block an A: the arrow pile (peaked, spills out of the window), the console (small and pale), and the nav Home icon (~0.7x). After those: the capsule window bevel, the workers' thin arms and walkie pose, and the streak badge's small flags.

The layout matches V1 t=0 / store 8, and logoArrowOut sits at the original logo's spot and size (x 21-218, y 65-217 pt; ours scaled to 197 pt wide). It reads in the original's style: blue plate + yellow bubble word + purple OUT! arrow plate. Its letters are narrower than 'MAZE' (svg family, not graded here). The cast and backdrop miss: the scientist's pose/costume, the carrier's size and box, a floating crowd, a flat backdrop with a noise band, and no contact shadows on anyone.
